strings.name: Magic Johnson
strings.summary: Johnson’s passing and fast-break leadership as a tall point guard made him central to the Lakers’ “Showtime” era and five NBA championships. He disclosed an HIV diagnosis and retired in 1991, later winning Olympic gold and briefly returning to the NBA. He subsequently developed businesses and sports investments while advocating HIV education and challenging stigma.

strings.influence.rationale: An NBA champion and model point guard who advanced basketball’s commercial reach and participated in public health advocacy.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Lakers cornerstone
strings.highlights.h1.text: Five NBA championships and three regular-season MVP awards.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Health advocacy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Promoted education and challenged stigma after disclosing HIV.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Basketball Hall of Fame
strings.timeline.t1.text: Inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Brief comeback
strings.timeline.t2.text: Played 32 regular-season games for the Lakers, then retired again.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Olympic gold
strings.timeline.t3.text: Won in Barcelona with the United States “Dream Team.”
strings.timeline.t4.title: Disclosed HIV diagnosis
strings.timeline.t4.text: Announced HIV infection and withdrew from that NBA season; HIV is not synonymous with AIDS.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Third MVP
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won his third NBA regular-season MVP award.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Rookie championship
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won the title with the Lakers and earned Finals MVP.
strings.timeline.t7.title: College title and draft
strings.timeline.t7.text: Led Michigan State to the NCAA title and became the first NBA draft pick.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered college
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined Michigan State University’s basketball team.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Commanders ownership
strings.timeline.t9.text: Joined the Josh Harris group purchasing the NFL’s Washington Commanders.
strings.timeline.t10.title: Dodgers investment
strings.timeline.t10.text: Joined Guggenheim Baseball Management as a co-investor in the Los Angeles Dodgers.
